title: My game got 128 wishlists
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Thank you so much for 128 wishlists!
    
    
    I know that might not seem like much to some of you, but it really means a lot to me, especially since this is my first Steam game and I absolutely hate marketing and I'm terrible at it.
    
    
    It still feels surreal that 2^7 people are now waiting for my game to be released!
    https://store.steampowered.com/app/3975540/FLAIR/?beta=1

comments.author: Thin_Medicine3833
comments.body: How long did it take to reach this wishlist?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Around 3 months but 90% of them Came in the last month because before that there was no gameplay Trailer. That helped me a lot

comments.author: Aware-Lingonberry-31
comments.body: I pray that Anti AI movement doesn't find this game and bomb rate it to oblivion. All being said, this is a very cool take on LLM integration to game. Good luck with the release!

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body:
Thank you so much :) 
Yeah you are right. Anti AI movement made me already almost give up but I keep going!

comments.author: Inevitable-Sport2495
comments.body: Looks great, very similar concept to You vs Zombies, which was just selected for the London games festival.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Thanks! Is the Zombie Game also AI based?

replies.author: Inevitable-Sport2495
replies.body: Yeah, the steam page describes, in detail, what is happening behind the scenes

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Okay. I will Look into that. Thank you!!

replies.author: Traditional_Law5082
replies.body: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224660/YOU\_vs\_Zombies/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224660/YOU_vs_Zombies/) \- playtest sign up on the steam page
